description: Published forward sailing schedules on an origin→destination lane: carrier, vessel, voyage, ETD/ETA, cut-offs and routing (leg count, transshipment ports, distance, CO2 per TEU and the port-by-port route_legs where the carrier publishes them; null where they do not), soonest first, from each carrier's own published schedules. Use this to find concrete upcoming departures to book. Every schedule time (published_departure, published_arrival, cut-offs, route_legs times, the from window) is the local time of its own port as the line publishes it, written without a timezone offset (2026-10-01T13:00:00): quote the digits and do not convert them; departure_precision/arrival_precision say minute (a time) or day (a date only); only retrieved_at is UTC and carries an offset; use transit_days for voyage length. The answer also carries carriers: one entry per line with carrier_code, carrier_name and count (its sailings in this answer; the counts add up to count), most first. An entry has error only when that line was asked live for this lane in this request and gave no answer: timeout (no answer in time), failed (error or unreachable), or paused (not asked; it timed out twice in a row here, retried after 6 h). A line that answered it has no sailings carries no error, and a line in error is listed even at count 0.

from.description: Earliest departure date as YYYY-MM-DD, with no time and no timezone offset. Must be today or later. Sailings are returned from 00:00 of that date, read in each port's local time, onward. Omit for today.

name: get_schedules
